title: Implement Sequential CEO Autopilot S12 run_task preflight reporting
verifyCommands: git diff --check HEAD -- src/core/sequential-ceo-autopilot.ts src/cli.ts tests/sequential-ceo-autopilot.test.ts tests/cli.test.ts references/initiatives/sequential-ceo-autopilot.md
instructions: Implement only S12 for references/initiatives/sequential-ceo-autopilot.md. Add deterministic report-only run_task preflight support for the closed runTaskCandidate object defined in references/initiatives/sequential-ceo-autopilot-s11-run-task-preflight-boundary.md. Do not execute run_task, call runTaskCommand, call executeWorkerDispatch, dispatch workers, create worktrees, write run logs from continuation, mutate lifecycle state, merge, cleanup, commit, push, execute batch_plan, or bypass existing run-task gates. Keep the implementation local to the continuation artifact validator/report and continuation:show visibility. Add or update focused core tests and CLI tests. The artifact schema may accept optional runTaskCandidate: null or object; absent/null should not block a valid artifact. A present candidate must be closed-schema validated. Prefer a report field named runTaskPreflight on continuation:show, omitted when absent, and included when accepted or blocked. Validation order must be: validate the current continuation artifact before consuming runTaskCandidate; reject active stop conditions; require currentSlice.status ready, currentSlice.actionType run_task, dependencyStatus met, requiredRuntime codex-sdk, executionMode preflight_only, worktreePolicy samantha_allocated_isolated, lifecycleOwner samantha; normalize taskSpecPath as a repo-relative local references/tasks/*.json path; reject prose, command strings, URLs, absolute paths, traversal, environment expansion, globs, empty strings, missing files, off-repo paths, invalid JSON, invalid TaskSpec fields, untracked or dirty TaskSpecs, stale taskSpecCommit evidence, push requirements, and any side-effect request. Parse the TaskSpec JSON and compare runTaskCandidate targetFiles, forbiddenChanges, and verifyCommands against both the TaskSpec and the currentSlice handoff. Confirm expectedSideEffects flags remain false. The accepted report must include normalized taskSpecPath, resolvedTaskSpecPath, task id/title, blockingReasons: [], trustedStateChanges: false, pushPerformed: false, and false side-effect flags. Blocked reports must include ordered deterministic blocking reasons and false side-effect flags. CLI tests must prove continuation:show exposes accepted and blocked runTaskPreflight reports without creating runs or worktrees and without mutating input files. Core tests must cover accepted committed-clean TaskSpec, malformed candidate, unsafe path strings, missing/off-repo files, untracked or dirty TaskSpec, stale taskSpecCommit evidence, active stop condition, non-run_task action type, runtime/mode/ownership mismatch, handoff mismatch, and push/side-effect rejection. Update references/initiatives/sequential-ceo-autopilot.md to mark S12 completed and set exactly one next ready slice: S13 dogfood of S12 preflight reports against committed TaskSpec candidates without executing run_task. Do not implement S13. End with exactly one HARNESS_RESULT line.
